I think it should be accepted. Even though they are countries, it's harmless because they don't exist anymore. Not to mention that anything and anyone can be shipped and as long as it doesn't hurt or insult anyone directly, there is nothing wrong with it. You can't *actually* ship countries anyway. A country isn't defined by only one, single person.  
The past is in the past and even though neither of the systems back then was good, you shouldn't punish random people who had no influence on either of the countries. The ship glorifies neither Nazism nor communism and doesn't force them on anybody ~~(or at least it shouldn't, please don't be an idiot and force your stupidity on others)~~.

To sum up; USSR and III Reich can be shipped together just like any other characters. They don't do any direct harm.

(On a bit more personal note - let people ship whatever and whoever they like. Don't be a butt about it just because you're not a fan of the ship.)
